scorecard.venue: Bharat Ratna Shri Atal Bihari Vajpayee Ekana Cricket Stadium, Lucknow

batting.name: AK Markram
batting.dismissal: c RA Tripathi b KK Ahmed

batting.name: RR Pant
batting.dismissal: c MS Dhoni b M Pathirana

batting.name: A Badoni
batting.dismissal: st MS Dhoni b RA Jadeja

batting.name: SN Thakur
batting.dismissal: c SK Rasheed b M Pathirana

batting.name: SK Rasheed
batting.dismissal: c N Pooran b Avesh Khan

batting.name: RA Jadeja
batting.dismissal: c AK Markram b Ravi Bishnoi

batting.name: V Shankar
batting.dismissal: c Avesh Khan b DS Rathi

balls.text: a slower ball at the stumps, Shardul stays in his crease and spoons the catch to mid-off, LSG have been restricted to their lowest total this season
Shardul finds the boundary, via a top-edged pull, tried to swipe that from outside off stump but there's no fielder behind the keeper
short of a length and straight, Shardul swings it into the gap at deep midwicket and they come back for the second, Miller won't have the strike
Sprays it wide outside off this time, Shardul reaches for it but it's too far away
Shardul swipes at a good length ball outside off and misses
full and down leg side once again, Pathirana not landing his yorkers

that's gone miles in the air and it settles into Dhoni's safe hands, CSK making a strong finish in Lucknow. Pant took his hand off the bat as he flailed at a fuller and slightly slower ball, and could only manage a top edge that went straight up. Gone for 63 off 49 balls

full and down leg side, they try and steal a bye but Dhoni's not having it. He moves to his left and collects the ball and lobs it over the sprinting Samad to hit the stumps direct, that's lovely from MSD
squeezed out from the blockhole to deep point for a single

sprayed wide outside off, surely that's a wide? The umpire hasn't called it. Pant reviews and gets the wide decision in his favour. I think Pant wants it called a no-ball because it pitched off the cut strip, but that was past the batter.
pace-on and the short ball disappears, there was enough width for Samad to free his arms and pull the ball over the deep square leg boundary
top-edged pull, a tough chance for the fielder running back from mid-off and he drops it, Shaik Rasheed it was
pace off this time, and much more effective. Pant moves outside the off stump to try and scoop and misses the connection
length ball with pace on, and pace on is not the way to go on this pitch. Pant gets under it and launches the ball high and far over the straight boundary
flat-batted from the crease down the ground for just the single
length ball on leg, slanting across the right-hander from over the wicket, Samad moves across and swings to long leg
full and slanting into the pads, Samad can't make contact and they run a leg bye towards midwicket
tries to slam the ball over midwicket but gets a toe end to cover, direct hit at the bowler's end and Pant was out by a long way, missed though
dug in short just outside leg, Pant moved across his stumps and then lets it go, the umpire doesn't call it wide

one hand comes off the bat as he makes contact with the pull but the contact is sweet enough to send the ball into the stands beyond deep midwicket, brings up a fifty with that shot. Pant's found some power now when LSG really need it
aiming for the blockhole again but doesn't quite hit it, Pant drills the ball through covers
finally! Pant dispatches a full and straight ball with a helicoptered whip off the pads over the wide long-on boundary. That was pace-on from Pathirana and a half-volley too
the yorker but it's wide down leg side and Dhoni can't collect cleanly
Noor Ahmad ends a fabulous spell, just 13 runs conceded in four overs. Pant pulls the last ball towards deep square and Vijay Shankar has to run to his left to cut off the boundary
once again he can't find the gap at cover with the cut, Pant is stagnating at the death

oh Pant is struggling now, misses another slog sweep and gets hit on the body, the ball falls close and in front of  the stumps on the leg side, Dhoni collects and back hands it on to the stumps, but Pant grounded his bat in time
backs away and punches the ball into the covers, can't find the gap
Pant tries to slog sweep but loses balance and falls over in his crease, the ball hits him on the pad
swings across the line, along the ground to deep midwicket
short ball, pulled to deep backward square where Vijay Shankar makes good ground to his right to prevent the boundary
he's hammered this though! Pathirana went fuller and outside off, Samad cleared his front leg and slammed the ball flat and far over deep cover
short ball outside off, and Samad misses the pull, was no where close to making contact there
quick single, Pant has to hurry but makes it. He dug one out of the blockhole and Samad called him through for the single, Pathirana did the fielding and throwing himself
140 kph dug into the pitch short of a length, Pant mis-times the pull to midwicket, the ball is definitely not coming on to the bat now
driven down the ground for a single, low full toss at the stumps that was
tries to cut a quick one outside off but misses
that's so close! Pant cuts the ball front right in front of his stumps and bottom edges it towards short third
pokes from the crease at a ball that drifts across him from over the wicket, outside edge to short third where the fielder dives to cut it off
tossed up on off stump, driven to long off for a single
tries to nudge off his pads but misses
tosses up a full ball outside off, Pant backed away towards leg and yorked himself, thankfully for him it was not on the stumps
bowled short outside off, angling into the left-hander from over the wicket, Pant pulls to deep midwicket
worked off the pads from inside his crease through midwicket

this time there's no question he's out! Stumped by the proverbial mile. Came down the pitch too early, far too early. Too easy for Jadeja to shorten his length and fire it quick and wide past the reach of the right-hander. Dhoni had so much time he could have stumped him multiple times. Oh my what now?? Badoni is waiting on the boundary edge as they wait to see if Dhoni has collected the ball in front of the stumps, in which case it would be another no-ball! Surely he can't get this lucky! He doesn't, Dhoni's gloves are fine and Jadeja is just relieved.
goes back and works the ball off the pads through midwicket
pushed close on the leg side for a quick single, Jadeja rushes through but misses the direct hit at the bowler's end

lbw! And Badoni reviews. He tried to reverse sweep one that angled into him from around the wicket and missed. That's hit him just above the knee roll on the front pad. Looks close. Ultra Edge is taking a while and when it arrives it indicates a small slike as the ball passes the bottom of the glove before it hits the pad. It's a really small spike but it's enough to save Badoni
slower ball around middle and off from over the wicket, Pant plays it towards cover
fuller ball outside off, driven from inside his crease towards deep point

spooned straight to deep third and CSK have another breakthrough! Badoni reached for the short and wide ball outside off, he had to really stretch for it and then opened the face to try and upper cut it. One hand came off the bat as he made contact and he didn't time it at all. But hang on, they are checking something. Likely whether this was the third ball above shoulder height in the over. Pathirana is allowed two such balls but this is indeed the third! It's a no-ball, so LSG have a free hit coming up. Michael Gough, the TV umpire, rules it was just above shoulder height.
Pathirana raises his hand in half an appeal but the umpire isn't having it ... short ball down leg side, Badoni tried to pull but missed
bouncer, perhaps the first one today? Badoni sways out of the way
dabbed from the crease to deep third for a single
played back to the bowler, no width from Pathirana this time
full and wide outside off, Pant drills the ball hard along the ground to the cover boundary, his back leg seemed to skid a touch as he made contact with the ball but the connection was sweet

this is superb batting, Overton overcompensates this time by going straighter, Badoni is ready and waiting, moving inside the line of the ball and towards the off and hoisting it high and far over the fine leg boundary
superb contact this time! Too full with plenty of width outside off, Badoni frees his arms and launches the ball over the cover boundary
good length outside off, slower delivery, Badoni tries to slog across the line and misses
backs away and swipes at one that angles across him but misses, Dhoni misses the take as well as the ball bounces in front of him
fuller ball and on a straighter line, Badoni opens the face to drive the ball through point
Overton bowls a floater short of a length and wide outside off, Badoni thinks about reaching for it but lets it go in the end
he shaped up to slog sweep but then saw the line was too wide and the length wasn't full enough and ended up dabbing to short third

was that an edge? Pant went back and cut the ball and Dhoni didn't catch it. There was a sound on that one, but not sure of the edge yet. Indeed there was, big edge, big deflection so it was a really tough chance
nudged off the front foot towards point for a single
Badoni sweeps but can't beat short fine leg
played behind square for a single, that was slog swept from outside off
leans forward and nudges the ball off the pads for a single
pushed through midwicket for a single to end the over
oh my! Nothing tentative about this! Dances down the pitch and lofts the ball inside out to the cover boundary
Jadeja aborts the appeal because there is an inside edge on to the pad, Badoni had such a tentative poke at that

bowled him! How many times have you seen this from Jadeja before? Skids the ball in off a good length into the right-hander from around the wicket. Wasn't short enough to pull; Marsh missed it and heard it crash into his stumps
gets down on one knee and slog sweeps behind square this time
that's a lucky break for Pant, he's bottom edged the sweep from wide outside off between Dhoni's legs for a boundary
leans across his stumps and flicks a fuller ball through midwicket
wicket to wicket line, Marsh hangs back and pulls to deep midwicket. Noor's speeds have been between 97 and 100 kph
slower pace to Pant who nudges off his pads for a single to midwicket
pulled to deep square leg for a single, that was a straighter line
wide again outside off, Marsh tries to slam it through the off side and misses again, Noor is firing it through quick
swings hard at one that angles across him from over the wicket and misses it completely
bowled very wide outside off at serious pace! Marsh lets it go
played back to the bowler watchfully
misses the slog sweep this time, tried to drag it from wide outside off and came on to him too slowly
Pant is ticking today, goes back in his crease and brings his hands down quickly to cut the ball hard and fine of the fielder at deep third
played to deep cover again for just the single this time
that is some adjustment from Marsh! He looked like he was backing away to hammer the ball but it came on to him slowly, he then waited for the ball and drove it so smoothly to the cover boundary
dragged short outside off, Pant stays in his crease and cuts towards deep point
cramped for room on the cut and he bottom edges the ball into the ground towards Dhoni
played off the hips behind square for a single
Pathirana shows off his football skills on the fine leg to cut off the boundary, Pant had got inside the line and pulled the ball along the ground
that's in the stands beyond deep third, and that's been dispatched via some sort of a reverse scoop. Make great connection, and some signs of vintage Pant tonight
driven to long on for another single
pulled along the ground to deep square leg for one more
played into the covers, LSG finish the powerplay with only 42. CSK have exceeded expectations so far tonight.
quick single, very quick, Pant has to hurry! He was on the move as he pushed the full ball towards mid of and set off immediately, in the end there was no direct hit
Marsh moves forward and across and punches one that angles into him towards long on for a single
opens the face and guides a length ball towards third man for a single
shot! Length ball and Pant dismisses it from his presence with a powerful swing across the line, one-bounce four to square leg
clipped off the pads, Pathirana did well to dive to his right to cut it off at short fine leg, else he would have had some chasing to do
punched crisply to mid-on off the front foot to end the over
another leave from an LSG batter tonight, Pant moves forward and shoulders arms to a good length ball outside off
pushed into the covers for a single

over deep midwicket this time! Lots of hang time on this ball and it clears the boundary comfortably. Khaleel pitched up on leg and middle stump and Marsh planted his front foot forward and lofted it powerfully
swings the short of a length ball off his hips and beats Kamboj running to his right at long leg
over the wicket, angling across the right hander, Marsh lets it go again, his fourth leave of the innings

huge appeal for lbw turned down, Kamboj is imploring the umpire with no luck. Dhoni eventually takes the review. Kamboj bowled a much fuller ball angling into Pooran who tried to swing across the line and missed. That looks good and DRS returns three reds! That's hitting leg stump with the angle into the left-hander from around the wicket and Pooran has got to go
goes around the wicket and angles the ball into the left-hander, Pooran stays in his crease and drives to point
Pooran's had enough sighters, he lines up a pretty good length ball and swings across the line, not the greatest connection but he's placed it into the gap on the square leg boundary
good length on off again, no room for Marsh to free those monstrously strong arms, he plays a rather deft dab into the covers for a single
not as full now and Marsh stays in his crease and dabs towards point
first six of the game, Marsh launches the length ball on the up off the front foot over the long-off boundary

135 kph on a good length just outside off stump, Pooran stays in his crease and tries to play a cut-drive and misses. CSK have made a really good start, and this pitch doesn't seem to be a batting beauty so far
has a wild swipe at a length ball wide outside off without moving his feet and makes no contact

not convincing! not convincing at all from Pooran but such is life for the bowlers these days that it has gone for four to the fine leg boundary. Pooran slogged at a short of a length ball outside off, aiming for deep midwicket, but top edged it
Okay I haven't seen these many leaves in the IPL in a long time. This one wasn't technically a leave, Pooran began to drive at it and then kind of aborted the shot as the ball was wide outside off
length ball outside off, Pooran stays in his crease and defends on the off side
short of a length at the body from over the wicket, the ball doesn't get too high, Marsh moves across his crease and swivel pulls off his hips towards long leg
now Pooran lets it go as the ball slants across him from short of a length ... four leaves in this over. LSG batters trying to suss this pitch out before deciding their approach?
nudged towards mid-on for a quick single, a disciplined start from the youngster Kamboj
tight line and length outside off with some movement away from Marsh, he prods at it off the front foot towards point
three leaves in a row now, something's got to give now surely. Marsh came forward a bit this time and then shouldered arms
two leaves in a row! Good length outside off again and Marsh continues to have a sighter
good length outside off with some shape away from the right-hander, Marsh lets it go

What a catch that is! Rahul Tripathi has brought the CSK fans to life in this crowd with a sensational catch. Markram tried to whip a straight ball that was angling across him towards the leg side and got a leading edge that went miles in the air over point. Tripathi tracked back at top speed and judged it to perfection, lunging to grab it as it fell over his head. Is that the inspiration CSK need tonight?
wide again outside off, Markram goes back and across and cuts to wide third man, that sweeper comes into play immediately - Rachin makes a diving save!
straighter line, wicket to wicket, Markram plays it back to the bowler
not much bounce in this pitch so far, Markram stays back and uses the width outside off to drive the ball from his crease through the covers, LSG are away
shorter length, wider outside off, slanting across the right-hander ... Markram has a swish at it but the ball passes under the bottom of the bat
length ball on a wicket to wicket line from over the wicket from the left-armer, Markram meets it on the front foot and defends with a straight bat on the leg side

that's the win for CSK! It's been a long, long time coming and Dube seals it by hitting a full ball hard to the cover boundary. Lucknow erupts in celebration as the home team loses, but such is the love for CSK around this country, they now have their second win of the season, after ending a run of five straight defeats.
in the blockhole and Dhoni digs it out to cover, quick single
Dube hands it over to Dhoni again by playing the ball along the ground to deep point
a rank full toss to cap Shardul's horror night and Dhoni dispatches it easily, pulled with power and it bounces just inside the midwicket boundary
in the blockhole outside off, Dube digs it out to deep point
played back to the bowler and Shardul manages to stop it
sprayed wide outside off stump and Shardul's horrible night continues, he's gone for more than 50 on a pitch where batting has been quite hard
is that a drop at cover? Hit hard and flat to Bishnoi at cover and the ball bursts out of his hands, and the Lucknow crowd is cheering this drop too
driven to long on for a single now to give the strike to Dhoni

oh my goodness! Shardul loses grip of this one and sends down a high full toss, that's going to be a no ball, and that's gone all the way for six over deep third too! Dube got under it and sliced it hard and far, fielder on the boundary had no chance
this time the diving fielder at third man can't prevent the boundary! Dube opens the face and steers the wide full toss slanting across him, makes great contact and uses the pace of the ball
edged and edged wide of short third, but there's a fielder in the deep too and he runs to his right to slide and save the boundary.
Dube's not able to find his range tonight. Low full toss angling across the left-hander, Dube tries to steer it rooted inside his crease and gets an edge into the ground to the keeper
low full toss and straight, Dube hits it hard into the ground and towards the bowler
launched flat and hard from inside his crease but not wide enough of long-off to find the boundary, Miller runs to his left and makes the save
edged and four! Dhoni swings hard at a full and wide ball outside off, wide of the keeper, fine of short third. It's happening for CSK, the gap is closing
in the blockhole just outside off, Dube opens the face and digs it out to deep third

It's in Dhoni's swinging arc and it's disappeared over the square leg boundary! Slower one, and Dhoni swung hard at it, taking one hand off the bat as he made contact, hit it well enough to land only the second six of the innings
in the blockhole just inside the wide line this time, Dhoni reaches for it and digs it out back to the bowler
another one outside off stump as Shardul tries to hug the wide line and goes too far
Thakur goes wide and slow to Dhoni, too wide outside off this time
another full toss, a higher one outside off, slanting across Dube who bashes it from inside his crease, the fielder on the edge of the circle at cover dives to his left and saves runs, Bishnoi it was
full toss outside off, Dube tries to smash that ball so hard but misses
finds the gap this time! Gets plenty of width and the length isn't in the blockhole, Dube drives hard and to the cover boundary
Dube can't find the gap, drilled one from the blockhole to the man at cover
two in two! This time he opens the face late to steer a length ball wide of the wicketkeeper and fine of the fielder on the deep third boundary
hits the gap between extra cover and mid off and Lucknow erupts! Dhoni stayed in his crease and swatted hard at a length ball, hitting it along the ground
length ball with width outside off, Dhoni misses the cut, was late on the shot
in the blockhole, dube tries to slam it down the ground and ends up slicing it in the air over cover point
strays on to the pads and Dhoni glances it to fine leg for a single. CSK have got to get going. Soon.
fuller ball and the cheers go up in the crowd as Dube digs it out towards cover for a single to bring No. 7 on strike
sprayed wide outside off stump from over the wicket across the left-hander

Rathi brings out the Hasaranga celebration as Avesh completes the catch at short third! He didn't look comfortable under that catch but managed to hold on! Shankar tried to go big down the ground with the asking rate now above ten, and he ended up slicing it in the air off the edge.
goes back and nudges the ball through midwicket for one more
Pant whips off the bails and brings the TV umpire into play. Dube tried to loft the ball down the ground but was beaten by the angle across him from over the wicket. Back foot is safely grounded.
played off the back foot into the covers
Dube gets squared up by one that pitches around leg and spins across him, gets an edge into the off side
dabbed off the pads behind square for a single
wicket to wicket line from around the wicket, Dube dabs gently on the front foot, Pant scampers across to prevent the single. Markram has completed an invaluable spell for LSG
wicket to wicket, milked off the pads for a single through midwicket, like the middle-overs of an ODI right now
nudged into the off side for another single
drives the ball along the ground for a single to long on
hit hard off the back foot along the ground to long off
goes back and nudges on the off side for one.

Bishnoi thinks he has a case for lbw as they run a leg bye. Shankar tried to work the ball off the pads and missed, that was certainly down leg but LSG have reviewed the not out decision! Strange one this. No bat, oh but it's umpire's call on leg stump. Much closer than it looked live. Shankar survives.
full ball down legside, Shankar misses the sweep
no flight to Dube, flat and quick around off stump, cut off the back foot through cover point
chipped in the air towards long off, reaches the fielder on the first bounce
starts with a precisely-placed lofted chip to the gap on the cover boundary! More air from Bishnoi, Shankar did not try to hit it too hard, focused on placement

straight to long on! Jadeja has struggled for momentum and now tries to smash a slightly tossed up ball over the straight boundary, doesn't get the elevation or distance and Markram judges it well on the boundary
slides down leg side from around the wicket, quick ball, Jadeja misses the sweep
Jadeja stays back to Bishnoi and opens the face, can't find the gap at short third
Dube leans forward and pushes back towards the bowler, Markram dives to his right and makes the stop
Jadeja leans forward and taps the ball to long on for a single
cut off the back foot through point
played back to the bowler from the crease, bowled flat and straight on a fuller length
first six of the innings! Too short from Markram this time, and Dube has plenty of time to go back and free those long arms and pull the ball into the stands at deep midwicket
cut off the back foot towards point
played off the pads through square leg for a single to finish the over
Dube's seen enough, he goes big, gets under the ball and lofts it down the ground, but superb fielding in the deep from Markram who relays it to Pooran as he dives on the straight boundary
defended from the crease on the off side
cut off the back foot along the ground for a single, CSK looking to take this deeeeep
pushed into the covers for a single

played off the back foot to long on, and there's some excitement at the non-striker's end as the bails come off and Jadeja plonks his bat in after getting sent back for the second run, he's safe though
slightly short, giving Jadeja the space to go back and pull, but softly along the ground for a single to deep midwicket
tries to cut but the ball is too close to off stump and he gets a bottom edge towards short third
Jadeja goes right back and works the ball off the pads behind square
stays in his crease and punches along the ground to long off
nudged gently in front of square leg for a single
Markram hits Jadeja's pads as he goes back to work the ball with the angle through leg, but that was missing the stumps
reaches for the ball slanting across him from over the wicket and drives to cover
caught and bowled! LSG are fighting back! Tripathi hits it straight back to Bishnoi, simple catch. He was no where near the pitch of this ball, had to reach for it and ended up chipping it in the air
leans forward and across and flicks the ball with the angle into him from around the wicket towards long on
tossed up outside off, Jadeja pushes forward and punches to cover
worked off the front foot in front of square leg, Tripathi sprints off wanting the second but Jadeja settles for one
driven firmly but to the fielder at cover

oh that looks plumb and he's been given lbw! Rachin has reviewed this but doesn't look confident. He tired to slog sweep a ball angling into him from around the wicket and missed. Wicket to wicket line. Hit on the back thigh in line with the stumps. No bottom edge or glove. Three reds, Rachin's got to go. Markram strikes in his first over!
goes back and lofts the ball wide of the fielder at long on for two more
pulled through square leg for another single
hit off the back foot to long on for a single
pulled along the ground into the gap on the wide long on boundary, giving them enough time for two
worked off the pads behind square for a single
width outside off and he cuts off the back foot to deep point, Shardul is a bit slow on his feet and can't prevent the second
Pant whips off the bails after Rachin misses the slog sweep but his back foot never left the crease
defended on the front foot
oh my, Samad has spilled a sitter! Tripathi miscued the googly, lofting it just beyond the 30-yard circle at mid off, Samad came running in from the boundary and dropped it
goes back and cuts a flat ball towards deep point
too short and Rachin rocks back and hits the ball hard and flat past the bowler, splits the fielders on the long off and on boundary
nudged off the front foot to mid-on, where Pooran is a touch deep to prevent the single
drags the sweep from wide outside off through square leg
nudged off the front foot towards short third
Tripathi gets going! Down on one knee to one on middle and leg and sweeps the ball behind square leg
plants his front leg forward and slog sweeps a straighter one to deep midwicket
skids across Rachin from over the wicket and he gets beaten on the cut
stays in his crease and defends a good length ball on off and middle stump

whoops, that's the end of a promising innings from Rasheed. Slower ball, short of a length and outside off. That's the first shot Rasheed has tried to hit with real power and he ended up top-edging the pull straight up. Pooran caught it safely at midwicket
full and straight, Rasheed clips the ball to midwicket
driven into the pitch and the ball bounces over the bowler's head for a single
pushed off the front foot through point and the running between the wickets is excellent to bring up the 50 partnership for CSK!
flayed to the point boundary! Length ball with lots of width at gentle pace, Rachin moves forward and drives the ball gracefully through the gap

slightly shorter and Rasheed whips the ball off his pads through the gap between square leg and short fine leg, he's not trying to smash the ball but is getting plenty of rewards for his timing and placement
nudged off the pads behind square, Rasheed wants one but Rachin says no
goes back to one that spins into him and gets hit on the pads, he was trying to work that through the leg side
drifts down leg side with the fuller ball, Rasheed misses the sweep
fuller ball, in the blockhole, Rasheed digs it out into the covers
bowled slow on a wicket to wicket line, nudged off the front foot into the covers
nudged off the back foot through midwicket
oh he begins with a wide down leg side, dragged it down really short and is lucky to not get punished
and he dispatches the final ball of the over with a gorgeous cover drive, through the gap and all along the ground
flicked off the pads behind square for a single
CSK are up and running big time! A full ball on middle stump, Rasheed simply chips it in the air over the infield between midwicket and mid-on

in the air but wide of the fielder at point for another boundary! Rasheed pushed hard at a full ball angling into his front pad, closing his face a touch to get a leading edge that flew through the gap
strides forward to a good length ball and pushes into the covers
clipped off the pads towards long on for a single
shot! It was a short ball and Rasheed sent it packing with a sublime swivel pull off the front foot, lofted it clean over the infield
second boundary for Rasheed, moves forward to a fullish ball and plays a chippy-punch wide of the bowler and straight enough to beat mid-on
tries to nudge the ball off his pads behind square but misses
picks up his first boundary with an elegant flick off the pads through midwicket, uppish and through the gap
good length with some zip outside off, Rasheed is late on the defence and gets beaten
angles the full ball in to the left-hander, driven back to the bowler, he gets a hand on it but can't field it cleanly
keeps his bat raised as the bowler runs in and moves forward a touch to drive a fullish ball to mid off, encouraging start for CSK
full toss, driven towards the bowler on the bounce, Shardul gets a hand on it and takes the pace off, they run a single to long off
too full and too straight this time, too easy again for Rachin and he flocks it off his pads for another boundary behind square
driven delightfully through the covers, front foot forward and a full swing of the bat, just too full and wide from Shardul, too easy
off the mark is young Rasheed with a nice, confident stride and punch into the covers, shardul is keeping it on a length around off stump
nice stride forward to his first ball and a punch to mid off, Rasheed is apparently opening fir the first time in T20s
